question: Into what proportional divisions may the paste be separated for application?
premises: Options include six, five, or four parts
inference: After dividing the paste sixteenfold, it may be applied in groupings of six, five, or four.
uncertainties: Exact grouping syntax of ṣaṭpaṃca caturaṃ is compressed
plain_english: Having divided the paste sixteenfold, one may use portions of six, five, or four.
